benefit_finance_desc: Project cost, loan limits, working capital and every quarterly payment.
benefit_action_desc: A small pilot and a lender conversation before a large commitment.
data_note: Planning estimates, with sources shown. Local field checks still matter.
existing_desc: Use Daily accounts to record income and expenses. Save a repayment plan to review upcoming instalments.

invalid_input: Enter a location, a business description and a positive amount (up to ₹10 crore).
clarify: Add the district to identify this village safely.
ambiguous: This name matches several places. Choose the district and add the block.
outside_state: This prototype covers Tamil Nadu. Enter a Tamil Nadu location.
district_proxy: Village not verified. This report uses a district-level scenario.
historical: Place matched in the historical directory. Boundaries may have changed.
uncertain: Business is unfamiliar. Generic estimates are shown; choose a category or add detail.
verdict_pilot: The base scenario supports a pilot. Demand and actual costs still need checking.
verdict_caution: Estimated cash or working capital is tight. Reduce fixed costs or validate more demand before taking a loan.
no_map: Density scenario only; businesses have not been counted or mapped.
outside_note: Project cost exceeds ₹50 lakh. No loan is routed under these two schemes. Discuss a smaller project or another financing route.
cap_note: The loan cap applies. The remaining gap needs additional own funds.
finance_intro: Your capital builds the project. Repayment must fit the business.
formula: Project cost = your margin ÷ 10%. Loan = 90% of project cost, subject to the scheme cap.
moratorium_note: No payment in the first {{grace}} months. First payment at month {{first}}; last at month {{last}}. Interest accrues during the grace period.
interest_assumption: Assumption: simple moratorium interest is added once to principal; quarterly reducing-balance payments follow. Confirm the lender’s policy.
eligibility_desc: Community, income, documents and lending-agency checks apply. Capital alone does not establish eligibility.
agency_sc: Ask the district TAHDCO office about access and current eligibility.
agency_other: For other communities, ask the district welfare office; BC/OBC applicants can explore TABCEDCO/NBCFDC. Terms differ.
operating: Can the business cover its costs?
break_even_units: Monthly units to cover costs & debt
no_break_even: Not achievable at this unit margin
projection_note: Sales ramp up over six months. Actual quarterly repayments are deducted when due. These are scenarios, not historical trends.
sources_title: Know what is measured. Know what is assumed.
sources_intro: Official directories identify places. Curated assumptions estimate local demand and costs. Every report keeps that distinction.
coverage_detail: {{districts}} districts, {{blocks}} historical blocks and {{villages}} historical panchayat records. Current LGD boundaries are not verified.
source_nabard: NABARD Tamil Nadu State Focus Paper, 2025–26
assumptions_population: Customer reach uses an assumed population density and reachable share around your selected area. Household counts and the range are estimates, not a village survey or road-distance analysis.
assumptions_market: Competition uses sector density priors; the block proxy assumes 1 lakh residents. Prices and purchasing-power multipliers are synthetic planning benchmarks, not live mandi prices.
assumptions_cost: Working capital covers 45 days of costs, 7.5 days of receivables and 6 days of supplier credit. Price, capacity and demand estimates limit sales.
model_desc: A trained small text classifier understands the business. Local document retrieval supplies evidence. An API or local open language model adds advice. Code calculates every financial amount.
model_metric: Curated holdout: {{count}} examples; accuracy {{accuracy}}. Small authored dataset, not real-world accuracy or business success probability.
ai_pending: Language model is adding advice; your plan is ready.
ai_fallback: Language model unavailable or response rejected. Curated guidance remains available.
ai_disclaimer: Generated advice can be wrong. Use it alongside the estimates and a local field check.
voice_error: Voice input is unavailable. Please type your idea.
empty: Create a plan to see your results here.
print_tip: Choose “Save as PDF” in your browser’s print window.
advice.market: Start with households and small shops within the selected radius. Test doorstep delivery and the weekly market; road access may reduce the reachable base.
advice.opportunity: Test a convenient delivery time, smaller affordable packs or reliable after-sales service. An underserved niche is a hypothesis until customers confirm it.
advice.strengths: A local customer base can support repeat purchases. Your own contribution gives a clear starting budget; begin within the working-capital allocation.
advice.weaknesses: Demand is unverified and the estimates may miss rent, wastage or family labour. Obtain supplier quotations and compare the working-capital gap before committing.
advice.threats: Keep a second supplier for transport or stock disruptions. Plan for monsoon and harvest-season demand changes. Avoid depending on one buyer; build several repeat customers.
advice.competition: The displayed density is a scenario, not a field count. Walk the market, record comparable sellers and compare opening hours, quality and customer credit before choosing a location.
advice.pricing: Treat the price range as a local trial range. Confirm input costs and customer willingness to pay; smaller packs can improve affordability without selling below cost.
advice.steps: Speak to potential customers, collect supplier quotations and run a small trial. Take this report to the district support office and confirm scheme eligibility and repayment terms before borrowing.

region.interior: Mixed farming, retail and local services
privacy: Saved only in this browser and the local server. Configured AI providers receive the business description and district.

scheme_intro: Explore schemes against your profile and budget. These checks indicate a possible match; the lending agency decides eligibility.

project_mismatch: This budget falls outside the scheme’s project range.
scheme_project_limit: Choose a scheme that fits your project budget.
use_scheme: Use this scheme in my plan

nbcfdc_note: The remaining contribution may be shared with the channel partner. This estimate conservatively treats it as your own funds. Confirm the sanctioned share and grace-period interest.

budget_health: Can this plan carry its repayments?
cash_positive: Estimated cash remains after costs and debt provision.

no_entries: No entries yet. Add your first income or expense.
invalid_entry: Enter a valid date and a positive amount with up to two decimal places.
planned_not_sanctioned: Planning schedule only. Replace with the lender’s sanctioned terms before recording actual loan payments.

no_tracked_plans: Save a repayment plan from the Repayments page.

welcome_intro: Plan a small business in Tamil Nadu. Understand local opportunities, setup costs and suitable loan options before deciding.
funding_choice: How will you fund your business?
choose_place: Choose the correct place below. Move the pin to your business site.
no_places: No matching map results. Enter coordinates or select a district.
coordinate_fallback: Pin saved. Address lookup unavailable. Select the correct Tamil Nadu district before continuing.
tiles_unavailable: Map background unavailable. Coordinates and saved places still work.
radius_fixed: Area shown: 15 km around your pin. Travel distance may differ.
map_wait: Please wait a moment, then search again.
savings_enough: Your savings cover this estimated starter budget. No loan is needed for this plan. Confirm local quotations first.
savings_and_loan: Use your own money first and a loan for the remaining setup cost. This is a repayment estimate, subject to eligibility and lender approval.
contribution_needed: This scheme does not cover the full shortfall. Arrange the funding gap shown before starting. A loan is not yet approved.
no_repayment: No loan payments or moratorium for a self-funded plan.
inventory_note: Illustrative starter allowances, not supplier quotations. Existing space or equipment reduces the budget. Confirm quantities, condition, permits and prices locally before buying.
tools_tailoring: Sewing machine, cutting table and tools
tools_fish: Fish handling tools and cold boxes
bank_map_note: Blue: banks. Brown: post offices. Nearby does not mean they offer this scheme. Confirm with the branch or authorised agency.
competitor_map_note: Red pins show mapped businesses that may sell similar products. Listings can be incomplete or outdated; visit locally to confirm. These are separate from the estimated competitor count.
verified_providers: Only verified providers of this scheme
no_verified_providers: No branch-level scheme providers verified in this dataset. Use the official agency link.
no_mapped_places: No matching listings returned. This does not mean there are no businesses or branches.
pin_required: Choose your business location on the intake map to see nearby places.
scheme_suggested: Option to explore: your entered community, income and project cost match the published screening criteria. This is not loan approval or a comparison of every lender.
women_allocation: NSFDC targets 40% of these scheme funds for women. This is not a guaranteed individual entitlement.
scheme_documents: Prepare identity/address proof, community certificate, family income proof, bank details and a business plan. Confirm the full checklist with the authorised agency.
lender_checks: Credit score, existing debt, overdue loans, collateral and guarantor rules need lender confirmation. No universal CIBIL cut-off or blanket ban on existing loans is assumed here.
gender_rule: The three listed schemes accept all genders; gender alone does not establish eligibility.
activity_check: The agency must accept your activity and assess business viability, required permissions and repayment ability.
scheme_coverage_limit: This prototype screens three schemes. If none fits, it does not mean you cannot get a business loan. Ask your bank about other suitable options.
score_note: Two points each for facilities, setup funding, estimated positive cash flow, working capital and verified market evidence. This is a checklist score, not your chance of success.
spatial_risk_note: The map shows your chosen site and recorded similar businesses as possible competition. Supply delays, seasons and buyer dependence are business risks without verified map locations; no risk pins are invented.
